hero.titleSmall: Not just a haircut — a quarter of an hour of quiet.
hero.lede: Fresh fades. Clean lines. Quiet confidence. We don't just cut your hair, we upgrade your style. Walk in ordinary, walk out unforgettable.

video.p: We don't rush. Every cut is considered, every line is drawn, every client leaves better than they arrived.

services.p: Honest prices, realistic timing, no surprises. Every service includes a facial cleanse and premium products.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.desc: Scissor and clipper cut, refreshing wash, facial cleanse and personalised styling.

items.title: Full Ritual (Hair & Beard)
items.desc: The essential package for gentlemen. Includes haircut, beard trim, facial cleanse and finish with premium products.

items.title: Family Tradition (Father & Son)
items.desc: A shared experience on side-by-side chairs. Full haircut and a style lesson for the next generation.

items.title: Simple Cut (Refresh)
items.desc: Clipper cut (minimum 3 mm). For the moments when you need a clean, essential refresh.

items.title: Simple Cut & Beard
items.desc: Short clipper cut paired with beard trim and hydrating products.

items.title: The Young Gentleman
items.desc: For our youngest clients. Patience, attention and a style cut to fit.

items.title: Beard Architecture
items.desc: Shape sculpting, razor contour, hydration and facial cleanse.

items.title: Refresh & Styling
items.desc: Wash, dry and professional styling. Ideal before an event or an important meeting.

items.title: House Indulgence (Full Experience)
items.desc: Craft without compromise: revitalising scalp massage, precision cut and beard architecture, accompanied by premium grooming products.

about.p1: The Men's Place opened in 2016 as an intimate workshop with just two chairs and a clear vision: absolute quality before volume. We chose not to rush time, but to turn every visit into a ritual of craft, giving today's man the distinction of times past.
about.pull: “A good haircut isn't a transaction — it's a pause. A quarter of an hour when no one asks anything of you.”

items.name: Levente Ninacs
items.bio: 10 years of craft. From the rigour of the classic cut to the precision of modern style, we turn the beard into a piece of facial architecture. All scissors, passion and absolute attention to detail.

items.text: I walked in tired and walked out a gentleman. Levi is a true craftsman — every detail counts.
items.name: Gergő Z.

items.text: The best premium package in town. The atmosphere, the scent of the products, the music — everything is considered.
items.name: Dávid B.

items.text: I've been coming for four years and haven't tried anywhere else. The cut holds perfectly for three weeks — that says it all.
items.name: Răzvan I.

booking.p: Chairs fill up fast. Use the Mero app to check availability and book your moment.

footer.tagline: A classic barbershop for gentlemen who appreciate craft, time well spent and a haircut done right.
footer.madeWith: Made with patience in Satu Mare
